scenario: Retention-domain (VBAT) hold-up across HW-SF-002 sub-event (ii) main-rail brownout to BOR level 3 (2.8 V) for 50 ms, followed by sub-event (iii) main-rail removal from BOR to 0 V for 100 ms (worst-case durations). Initial VBAT = 3.3 V (nominal 3V3 rail). Acceptance: VBAT(t) stays at or above the 1.65 V retention floor for the full 150 ms, and the trace matches oracle OR-001 within the declared tolerance. The 0.001 V tolerance is provisional pending H-02 vendor selection; rerun the ESR/R_path sensitivity analysis when those budgets are replaced by cited vendor data.
not_covered: HW-SF-002 sub-event (i) IWDG reset: firmware/reset-domain behavior, covered by the T2 virtual bench (H-02/H-03)
Charge-path turn-on and recharging dynamics: OR-001 is valid only with iCh=0; a future H-02 oracle covers this behavior
T4 physical correlation (real brownout shapes, golden measurement): bench-pending per HwRS section 5 seed list (oracle absence)
